scope: H2 actual statement with documented cap-limit adaptation

expanded_types.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (w : RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
  Measurable w →
    (∀ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), 0 ≤ w g) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable w (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun g => RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq g * w g) (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) →
          0 < RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) w →
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.NonnegativeLogConcave w →
              (1 - RectangleCLT.Companion.weightCovariance (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id w).PosSemidef ∧
                RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
                    (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightedScore (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id w) ≤
                  2 * RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) w *
                      RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq
                        (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMean (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id w) -
                    ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                      (RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq g - ↑r) * w g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r

∀ {r : ℕ} (P : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ),
  P.transpose = P →
    P * P = P →
      ∀ (β : RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
        Measurable β →
          (∀ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r), 0 ≤ β x) →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun g => β (P.mulVec g)) (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) →
              ∀ (w : RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
                Measurable w →
                  (∀ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), 0 ≤ w g ∧ w g ≤ β (P.mulVec g)) →
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable w (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) →
                      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun g => RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq g * w g)
                          (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) →
                        0 < RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) w →
                          RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) w *
                              RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq
                                (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMean (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id w) ≤
                            ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                w g * RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (P.mulVec g) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r +
                              2 * RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) w *
                                Real.log
                                  ((∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), β (P.mulVec g) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) /
                                    RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) w)
